selection: earliest parsed filename month_day_year, before payload
rules: Keep every source cycle in source order. Report observed last positive-current sample before first discharge and final negative-current sample, capacities and time/current integral. Sampled values do not prove exact charger termination. No automatic EOL or full-capacity qualification from low capacity; no deleting startup based on future rebound. Missing/ambiguous schema or budget failure STOP, no next file fallback. First file only cannot establish lifetime or cross-date cycle continuity.
